mods.name: Trevor+
mods.description: Trapper pelt-grinding companion for Hypixel SkyBlock. Quest timer and pelts/hour, mob finder with an on-screen box, Theodolite block highlight, rarity alerts, zone and cooldown tracking, and a movable HUD with a built-in settings menu. Client-side only.

mods.name: Trevor+ Lite
mods.description: Trapper pelt-grinding companion for Hypixel SkyBlock, without ESP. Quest timer and pelts/hour, Theodolite block highlight (visible blocks only), rarity alerts, Shuriken reminder, zone and cooldown tracking, and a movable HUD with a built-in settings menu. Client-side only.

releases.notes:
- **Custom rarity colours**: change the colour of each rarity (Trackable to Elusive) for the mob box, its label, banners and HUD text. Settings > Colours opens a colour picker with a saturation/brightness square and hue bar (every colour), R/G/B sliders and a hex code box you can type or paste into. "Default" puts a rarity back.
- **Trevor+ Lite is now on Modrinth.**
- Trevor+ Lite's update notice now checks Modrinth, where Lite is published, so it actually finds new versions.
- The update notice compares versions by semantic-versioning rules, so a beta never counts as newer than the release it leads to.

Requires Fabric API. Minecraft 26.2, Java 25, client-side only.

releases.notes:
- **Trevor+ Lite**: a new, separate download with every ESP feature removed (no mob box, glow outline or direction line; Theodolite blocks only where you can see them). Built from the same code and released together with Trevor+. Settings and stats are shared, so you can switch.
- **Behind-walls mode** for the mob box, glow outline and Theodolite blocks: *Always*, *Dim behind walls* (faded when something is in the way, full strength in sight) or *Only when visible*. In the menu, on the welcome screen, or `/trevorplus esp always|dim|visible`. New installs start on Dim; existing settings keep Always.
- **Mod Menu support** (optional): the Configure button opens the Trevor+ menu.
- **Update notice**: Trevor+ checks CurseForge once per game start and tells you in chat when a newer version is out, with a download link. Also shows as Mod Menu's update badge. Switch it off under "Check for updates" in the menu.
- **Click to accept**: a new way to take Trevor's quests without automation. When he offers one, a button appears for 5 seconds; one left click (or clicking it with chat open) accepts. Choose it under General > Accept quests or `/trevorplus accept click`. "Auto-accept" is now the *Automatic* option there.
- **Shuriken reminder per rarity**: pick which rarities the reminder fires for (Mob finder > Shuriken reminder, or `/trevorplus shuriken tier <rarity>`).
- **New settings menu**: sorted into categories (General, HUD, Mob finder, Theodolite, Alerts, Chat), with grouped sections, settings that depend on another one greyed out while it is off, and mouse-wheel scrolling.

Requires Fabric API. Minecraft 26.2, Java 25, client-side only.

releases.notes:
First public release.

- **Welcome screen** on first launch: quick setup (username, Vincent multiplier, sounds, auto-accept), the warp key, and shortcuts to the HUD editor and full settings. Reopen it any time with `/trevorplus welcome` or from the settings menu.
- Diagnostic commands are no longer part of the normal command list.
- Quieter log: routine quest events are only logged in debug mode.
- Auto-hide delay is configurable (menu or `/trevorplus autohide <seconds>`), and the warp key and auto-accept also switch off while hidden.
- Every chat line Trevor+ prints has its own toggle in the menu.
- The settings menu is paged when it does not fit on screen.

Requires Fabric API. Minecraft 26.2, Java 25, client-side only.
